title: Solar-assisted CO₂ heat pump achieves 18.7% COP increase as irradiance rises
content:
Researchers in Italy have tested a 10 kW dual-source heat pump using CO₂ as a refrigerant and air or photovoltaic-thermal collectors as heat sources. The results show that solar operation can improve heating performance under favorable irradiance conditions, while an optimized source-switching strategy delivers modest annual electricity savings.

title: UNSW researchers find east-west ground-mounted PV shows less degradation than single-axis tracking counterparts
content:
Researchers at the University of New South Wales found that east-west ground-mounted PV systems can experience up to 40% lower rates of certain degradation mechanisms than single-axis trackers. Their simulations showed that lower operating temperatures and reduced UV exposure could improve module reliability, particularly in remote installations.
